scope: Conservative manual screen, not an exhaustive factual certification. Original files are unchanged. Tokenization and model capability are audited separately at runtime.

upstream.verification: Both files byte-identical to this upstream commit.

probe_exclusions.beverage-source-wine: The counterfactual asks for a fruit, but barley is a cereal.
probe_exclusions.bird-color-swan: Colors depend on species; the eagle label is underspecified.
probe_exclusions.bird-country-eagle: The swan-to-England national-emblem relation is not well defined.
probe_exclusions.christmas-season: Seasons require a hemisphere; none is specified.
probe_exclusions.food-animal-honey: The counterfactual asks for an insect but labels a cow.
probe_exclusions.func-pumps-chambers: Lung lobes are not heart chambers; the counterfactual changes relation.
probe_exclusions.gem-source-pearl: The counterfactual asks for an animal but labels earth.
probe_exclusions.holiday-month-christmas2: Easter does not have a fixed month.
probe_exclusions.instr-hit-drums: Wooden objects used to strike an instrument do not describe piano keys.
probe_exclusions.rhyme-rain-neighbor: Belgium has more than one western neighbor; direction is underspecified.
probe_exclusions.super-populous-capital: Outdated China premise; India overtook China in 2023.
probe_exclusions.vehicle-power-bicycle: The counterfactual rider's power source is ill-formed for a train.
probe_exclusions.ex-city-continent-Toronto-Lyon: At least one label is only a prefix of a multi-word answer.

flexible_function_exclusions.countries/continent: North is an incomplete answer for North America; exclude the whole relation for balanced coverage.
flexible_function_exclusions.months/holiday: Biggest holiday is culture-dependent, Easter moves, and labels are fragments.
flexible_function_exclusions.animals/habitat: Sky/outdoors do not specify a unique natural habitat.
flexible_function_exclusions.numbers/square: twenty, forty and eighty are only prefixes of 25, 49 and 81.

latent_landmark_exclusions.the Ganges River: Transboundary landmark does not identify a unique country.
latent_landmark_exclusions.Lake Titicaca: Transboundary landmark does not identify a unique country.
latent_landmark_exclusions.the Western Wall: Country attribution in East Jerusalem is disputed.
latent_landmark_exclusions.the Church of the Holy Sepulchre: Country attribution in East Jerusalem is disputed.

latent_concept_exclusions.India: One canonical main-language label hides substantial linguistic diversity; excluded conservatively.

latent_v2: Excluded from default experiments: 1416 rows are four targets for 354 subjects preselected for GPT-2 XL capability. Use v1 for cross-model coverage; v2 requires a separately reported model-specific analysis.
limitations: Latent bridge v1 has one country-to-language relation, 100 source landmarks and four targets per prompt, not 400 independent questions.
Country/language labels simplify multilingual countries; retained labels are canonical continuations, not exhaustive accepted answers.
Single-token scoring undercounts valid synonyms, number forms and multi-token answers; report coverage for each tokenizer.
Anthropic flexible tasks explicitly mention the source; report separately from hidden intermediate tasks.
Do not select the best band on the same prompts and call its score held-out performance.
